providerDefect.description: The official anonymous local backend receives its generated instance control secret as the value following the --instance-secret argv flag.
exposureChannels: diagnostics that print unredacted process argv
providerDefect.scenarioImpact: RESEARCH-13-SECRETS fails and the provider is ineligible as the go-to choice for this app/version.

builderPropagation.description: The first isolation proof printed full backend argv and propagated the generated value into orchestration output.
builderPropagation.remediation: The exact r1 target was stopped and deleted, r2 rotated the secret, and subsequent proofs emitted only PID, executable, owner, bind address, and argv flag names.

metricWindow: Frozen before scenario work; all scenario results are an untimed extension.
